# Dashboards

<!-- Generated by `sourcegull monitoring generate` from crates/monitoring. Do not edit; change the definitions and regenerate. -->

Sourcegull's Grafana dashboards, one per service. They are generated from `crates/monitoring` into `deploy/docker/grafana/dashboards/` (in the Compose bundle, to import into your Grafana) and the Helm chart's dashboard ConfigMaps (`metrics.grafanaDashboards.enabled=true`); [README.md](README.md) shows how to set them up. Panels with alerts link to [alerts.md](alerts.md).

- [Sourcegull: web](#sourcegull-web)
- [Sourcegull: repo](#sourcegull-repo)
- [Sourcegull: worker](#sourcegull-worker)
- [Sourcegull: executor](#sourcegull-executor)
- [Sourcegull: blob](#sourcegull-blob)
- [Sourcegull: postgres](#sourcegull-postgres)

## Sourcegull: web

The web role serves the UI, the GraphQL and HTTP APIs, streaming search, code host webhooks and the executor API.

Grafana uid: `sourcegull-web`.

### web: HTTP requests

#### web_http_request_rate

**Requests per second by route**

Requests to the public listener by matched route pattern (`fallback` is the UI and raw files). Health checks and scrapes are left out.

```promql
sum by (route) (rate(sourcegull_http_requests_total{role=~"web|all",route!~"/metrics|/healthz|/readyz"}[5m]))
```

Owner: platform

#### web_http_5xx_ratio

**Share of requests answered with 5xx**

- Alert (warning): [web: share of requests answered with 5xx above 2% for 5m](alerts.md#web_http_5xx_ratio)
- Alert (critical): [web: share of requests answered with 5xx above 10% for 10m](alerts.md#web_http_5xx_ratio)

```promql
(sum(rate(sourcegull_http_requests_total{role=~"web|all",route!~"/metrics|/healthz|/readyz",status=~"5.."}[5m])) or 0 * sum(rate(sourcegull_http_requests_total{role=~"web|all",route!~"/metrics|/healthz|/readyz"}[5m])))
/ sum(rate(sourcegull_http_requests_total{role=~"web|all",route!~"/metrics|/healthz|/readyz"}[5m]))
```

Owner: platform

#### web_http_p90_latency

**90th percentile request duration by route**

- Alert (warning): [web: 90th percentile request duration by route above 5s for 15m](alerts.md#web_http_p90_latency)

```promql
histogram_quantile(0.9, sum by (le, route) (rate(sourcegull_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{role=~"web|all",route!~"/metrics|/healthz|/readyz|/.api/search/stream|/.api/compute/stream|/.api/blame/.*|/.api/scip/upload|/.api/files/.*|/.executors/.*"}[5m])))
```

Owner: platform

### web: Search and GraphQL

#### web_search_stream_p90_duration

**90th percentile streaming search duration**

Time from the request until the search stream ends, as users see it. Histogram buckets end at 60 s.

- Alert (warning): [web: 90th percentile streaming search duration above 20s for 15m](alerts.md#web_search_stream_p90_duration)

```promql
histogram_quantile(0.9, sum by (le) (rate(sourcegull_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{role=~"web|all",route="/.api/search/stream"}[5m])))
```

Owner: search

#### web_search_stream_requests

**Streaming searches per second by status**

Search requests from the UI, the API and `gull`. Errors inside a stream are sent as events and still count as 200.

```promql
sum by (status) (rate(sourcegull_http_requests_total{role=~"web|all",route="/.api/search/stream"}[5m]))
```

Owner: search

#### web_graphql_p90_duration

**90th percentile GraphQL request duration**

- Alert (warning): [web: 90th percentile GraphQL request duration above 5s for 15m](alerts.md#web_graphql_p90_duration)

```promql
histogram_quantile(0.9, sum by (le) (rate(sourcegull_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{role=~"web|all",route="/.api/graphql"}[5m])))
```

Owner: platform

### web: Code host webhooks

#### web_webhook_requests

**Code host webhook deliveries per second by status**

GitLab webhook deliveries (repository pushes, merge requests, pipelines) by response status.

```promql
sum by (route, status) (rate(sourcegull_http_requests_total{role=~"web|all",route=~"/.api/gitlab-webhooks|/.api/webhooks/.*"}[5m]))
```

Owner: source

#### web_webhook_rejection_ratio

**Share of code host webhooks rejected**

- Alert (warning): [web: share of code host webhooks rejected above 50% for 30m](alerts.md#web_webhook_rejection_ratio)

```promql
(sum(rate(sourcegull_http_requests_total{role=~"web|all",route=~"/.api/gitlab-webhooks|/.api/webhooks/.*",status!~"2.."}[30m])) or 0 * sum(rate(sourcegull_http_requests_total{role=~"web|all",route=~"/.api/gitlab-webhooks|/.api/webhooks/.*"}[30m])))
/ sum(rate(sourcegull_http_requests_total{role=~"web|all",route=~"/.api/gitlab-webhooks|/.api/webhooks/.*"}[30m]))
```

Owner: source

### web: Instances

#### web_instance_up

**Instances answering Prometheus scrapes**

1 while Prometheus can scrape the instance's internal listener (:6060), 0 when it cannot.

- Alert (critical): [web: instances answering Prometheus scrapes below 1 for 5m](alerts.md#web_instance_up)

```promql
up{role=~"web|all"}
```

Owner: platform

#### web_site_config_version

**Site configuration version loaded by each instance**

The site config version each process runs with. With the config in the database, all instances converge on the same version within seconds of a change; a lasting difference means an instance cannot reload it (its logs say why). With `SOURCEGULL_SITE_CONFIG_FILE`, versions count reloads per process and may differ.

```promql
max by (role, instance) (sourcegull_site_config_version)
```

Owner: platform

## Sourcegull: repo

Repo nodes clone and fetch repositories from the code hosts, build the text search index and serve git data and searches to the other roles over gRPC.

Grafana uid: `sourcegull-repo`.

### repo: Disk

#### repo_disk_free_ratio

**Free disk space on the data volume**

Measured by the repo node janitor (2 minutes after start, then hourly). The node pauses clones when free space is below both SOURCEGULL_REPO_PAUSE_CLONES_FREE_PERCENT (default 10%) of the volume and SOURCEGULL_REPO_PAUSE_CLONES_FREE_GIB (default 20 GiB); Site admin > Repo nodes shows the threshold.

- Alert (warning): [repo: free disk space on the data volume below 15% for 10m](alerts.md#repo_disk_free_ratio)
- Alert (critical): [repo: free disk space on the data volume below 5% for 5m](alerts.md#repo_disk_free_ratio)

```promql
min by (instance) (sourcegull_repo_disk_free_bytes{role=~"repo|all"} / sourcegull_repo_disk_total_bytes{role=~"repo|all"})
```

Owner: source

#### repo_disk_free_bytes

**Free bytes on the data volume**

Free space for clones, the search index and caches, measured hourly. A repo node needs about 1.5 times the size of its repositories.

```promql
min by (instance) (sourcegull_repo_disk_free_bytes{role=~"repo|all"})
```

Owner: source

### repo: Clones and fetches

#### repo_repo_update_rate

**Clones and fetches per second by kind and outcome**

Repository updates finished by the repo nodes: `clone` (first copy), `fetch` (scheduled or webhook-triggered update) and `reclone`.

```promql
sum by (kind, outcome) (rate(sourcegull_repo_updates_total{role=~"repo|all"}[5m]))
```

Owner: source

#### repo_repo_update_error_ratio

**Share of clones and fetches failing**

- Alert (warning): [repo: share of clones and fetches failing above 20% for 30m](alerts.md#repo_repo_update_error_ratio)
- Alert (critical): [repo: share of clones and fetches failing above 80% for 30m](alerts.md#repo_repo_update_error_ratio)

```promql
(sum by (kind) (rate(sourcegull_repo_updates_total{role=~"repo|all",outcome="error"}[30m])) or 0 * sum by (kind) (rate(sourcegull_repo_updates_total{role=~"repo|all"}[30m])))
/ sum by (kind) (rate(sourcegull_repo_updates_total{role=~"repo|all"}[30m]))
```

Owner: source

#### repo_repo_update_p90_duration

**90th percentile clone and fetch duration by kind**

Histogram buckets end at 60 s, so long clones show as 60 s.

```promql
histogram_quantile(0.9, sum by (le, kind) (rate(sourcegull_repo_update_duration_seconds_bucket{role=~"repo|all"}[15m])))
```

Owner: source

#### repo_update_queue_oldest

**Age of the oldest queued clone or fetch**

- Alert (warning): [repo: age of the oldest queued clone or fetch above 2h for 30m](alerts.md#repo_update_queue_oldest)

```promql
max(sourcegull_queue_oldest_queued_seconds{queue="repo_update_jobs"})
```

Owner: source

#### repo_update_queue_depth

**Queued and running clones and fetches**

Jobs in the `repo_update_jobs` queue. Scheduled fetches and webhook pushes add jobs; one queued job per repository at most.

```promql
max by (state) (sourcegull_queue_jobs{queue="repo_update_jobs",state=~"queued|processing"})
```

Owner: source

### repo: Repositories

#### repo_repos_by_clone_status

**Repositories by clone status**

Repositories known to Sourcegull (not deleted). `not_cloned` falls as the repo nodes clone new repositories.


Owner: source

**Repositories marked corrupt**


Owner: source


**Repositories by index status**


Owner: search

#### repo_index_repos_errored

**Repositories whose last index build failed**

Cleared by the next successful build. Site admin > Repositories shows the error per repository.

```promql
max(sourcegull_index_repos_errored)
```

Owner: search

### repo: Rebalancing

#### repo_repo_moves

**Repository moves between repo nodes by state**

After repo nodes are added or removed, the repositories whose node changes are copied to their new node (`queued`, `copying`), switched over (`flipped`, the old copy is kept for a few minutes) and then removed from the old node. Nothing moves until every repo node runs with the same node list.

```promql
max by (state) (sourcegull_repo_moves)
```

Owner: source

#### repo_repo_move_rate

**Repository moves finished per second by outcome**

`flipped`: copied and switched over; `reassigned`: the old node was gone, cloned from the code host instead; `retry`: an attempt failed and is retried; `failed`: gave up; `cancelled`: no longer needed.

```promql
sum by (outcome) (rate(sourcegull_repo_moves_total{role=~"repo|all"}[5m]))
```

Owner: source

#### repo_repo_move_throughput

**Bytes copied between repo nodes per second**

Pack data received by the repositories' new nodes.

```promql
sum by (instance) (rate(sourcegull_repo_move_bytes_total{role=~"repo|all"}[5m]))
```

Owner: source

#### repo_repo_moves_failed

**Repository moves that gave up**

- Alert (warning): [repo: repository moves that gave up above 0 for 30m](alerts.md#repo_repo_moves_failed)

```promql
max(sourcegull_repo_moves{state="failed"})
```

Owner: source

#### repo_instance_up

1 while Prometheus can scrape the instance's internal listener (:6060), 0 when it cannot.

- Alert (critical): [repo: instances answering Prometheus scrapes below 1 for 5m](alerts.md#repo_instance_up)

## Sourcegull: worker

Workers run the job queues (code host and permission syncs, SCIP uploads, bulk changes, search jobs, watches, trends, outbound webhooks) and the singleton background jobs.

Grafana uid: `sourcegull-worker`.

### worker: Job queues

#### worker_queue_depth

**Queued jobs by queue**

Jobs waiting for a worker, per queue table. Site admin > Background jobs shows the same counts with the newest failures.

```promql
max by (queue) (sourcegull_queue_jobs{state="queued",queue!~"codeintel_index_jobs|batch_spec_workspace_execution_jobs|repo_update_jobs"})
```

Owner: platform

#### worker_queue_processing

**Running jobs by queue**

Jobs a worker holds right now. Stalled jobs (no heartbeat) are returned to the queue by the resetters.

```promql
max by (queue) (sourcegull_queue_jobs{state="processing",queue!~"codeintel_index_jobs|batch_spec_workspace_execution_jobs|repo_update_jobs"})
```

Owner: platform

#### worker_queue_oldest_queued

**Age of the oldest queued job by queue**

- Alert (warning): [worker: age of the oldest queued job by queue above 6h for 30m](alerts.md#worker_queue_oldest_queued)

```promql
max by (queue) (sourcegull_queue_oldest_queued_seconds{queue!~"codeintel_index_jobs|batch_spec_workspace_execution_jobs|repo_update_jobs"})
```

Owner: platform

#### worker_queue_failed

**Failed and errored jobs kept by queue**

`errored` jobs are retried, `failed` ones are not. Growth means a job type keeps failing; Site admin > Background jobs lists the messages and can retry them.

```promql
max by (queue) (sourcegull_queue_jobs{state=~"failed|errored",queue!~"codeintel_index_jobs|batch_spec_workspace_execution_jobs|repo_update_jobs"})
```

Owner: platform

### worker: Code intelligence

#### worker_upload_processing_rate

**SCIP uploads processed per second by outcome**

`completed`, `errored` (retried) and `failed` (given up) upload processing runs.

```promql
sum by (outcome) (rate(sourcegull_codeintel_upload_processing_seconds_count[5m]))
```

Owner: code-intel

```promql
(sum(rate(sourcegull_codeintel_upload_processing_seconds_count{outcome!="completed"}[1h])) or 0 * sum(rate(sourcegull_codeintel_upload_processing_seconds_count[1h])))

```

Owner: code-intel

Histogram buckets end at 60 s, so larger uploads show as 60 s.


Owner: code-intel

#### worker_upload_processed_bytes

**SCIP upload bytes processed per second**

Size of the SCIP indexes turned into code graph data.

#### worker_autoindex_commits_considered

**Commits considered for auto-indexing per second**

Commits the auto-indexing scheduler looked at, on ref updates (`event`) and in its sweep.

#### worker_autoindex_jobs_queued

Owner: code-intel

#### worker_autoindex_rate_limited

**Auto-indexing passes skipped by the rate limit per second**

Repositories skipped because they were indexed too recently.

```promql
sum(rate(sourcegull_autoindex_rate_limited_total[5m]))
```

Owner: code-intel

#### worker_codeintel_coverage_repos

**Repositories by precise index coverage**

`up_to_date`: a completed index serves the default branch; `stale`: the newest index is not at the default branch tip and older than 7 days; `failing`: the latest index job or upload failed; `none`: an indexing policy applies but nothing is indexed; `not_targeted`: no indexing policy applies. Site admin > Index coverage lists the repositories. Refreshed every 5 minutes.

```promql
max by (state) (sourcegull_codeintel_coverage_repos)
```

Owner: code-intel

#### worker_codeintel_failing_repos_growth

**Growth in repositories whose precise indexing fails, over 6 hours**

- Alert (warning): [worker: growth in repositories whose precise indexing fails, over 6 hours above 0 for 1h](alerts.md#worker_codeintel_failing_repos_growth)

```promql
max(sourcegull_codeintel_coverage_repos{state="failing"}) - max(sourcegull_codeintel_coverage_repos{state="failing"} offset 6h)
```

Owner: code-intel

#### worker_codeintel_failing_repos_by_source

**Failing repositories by where the latest failure happened**

`index_job`: an auto-indexing job failed on an executor; `upload`: processing an uploaded index failed.

```promql

```

Owner: code-intel


Owner: code-intel

#### worker_codeintel_orphaned_blobs_deleted

**Orphaned upload files deleted per hour**

Owner: code-intel

#### worker_codeintel_retention_expired

Uploads the expirer marked expired; the janitor deletes them later. Uploads on commits the repo node does not know are skipped until it does.


Owner: code-intel

#### worker_codeintel_ranking_duration

**Duration of the last ranking run**

How long the last PageRank run over the code graph took.


Owner: code-intel

## Sourcegull: executor

Executors take auto-indexing jobs (`codeintel_index_jobs`) and server-side bulk change spec executions (`batch_spec_workspace_execution_jobs`) from the web role's executor API and run them in containers or Kubernetes jobs. Executor processes expose no metrics; this dashboard shows their queues, heartbeats and API traffic.

Grafana uid: `sourcegull-executor`.

### executor: Executors

#### executor_executors_active

**Executors sending heartbeats**

Executors that sent a heartbeat in the last minute (they send one every 5 s). Site admin > Executors lists them.

```promql
max(sourcegull_executors_active)
```

Owner: platform

#### executor_running_jobs

**Jobs running on executors**

Jobs the active executors report running, across both queues.

```promql
max(sourcegull_executor_running_jobs)
```

Owner: platform

#### executor_jobs_without_executors

**Queued executor jobs while no executor is active**

The number of queued executor jobs when no executor has sent a heartbeat for a minute, else 0.

- Alert (warning): [executor: queued executor jobs while no executor is active above 0 for 15m](alerts.md#executor_jobs_without_executors)

```promql
sum(max by (queue) (sourcegull_queue_jobs{queue=~"codeintel_index_jobs|batch_spec_workspace_execution_jobs",state="queued"}))
* on() (max(sourcegull_executors_active) == bool 0)
```

Owner: platform

### executor: Executor queues

#### executor_queue_depth

**Queued and running executor jobs by queue**

Jobs waiting for and held by executors.

```promql
max by (queue, state) (sourcegull_queue_jobs{queue=~"codeintel_index_jobs|batch_spec_workspace_execution_jobs",state=~"queued|processing"})
```

Owner: platform

#### executor_queue_oldest_queued

**Age of the oldest queued executor job by queue**

- Alert (warning): [executor: age of the oldest queued executor job by queue above 1h for 30m](alerts.md#executor_queue_oldest_queued)

```promql
max by (queue) (sourcegull_queue_oldest_queued_seconds{queue=~"codeintel_index_jobs|batch_spec_workspace_execution_jobs"})
```

Owner: platform

#### executor_queue_failed

**Failed and errored executor jobs kept by queue**

Failed auto-indexing jobs are shown per repository under Code graph > Index jobs; failed bulk change spec workspaces on the bulk change spec's execution page.

```promql
max by (queue, state) (sourcegull_queue_jobs{queue=~"codeintel_index_jobs|batch_spec_workspace_execution_jobs",state=~"failed|errored"})
```

Owner: platform

### executor: Executor API

#### executor_api_requests

**Executor API requests per second by route**

Heartbeats, dequeues, log updates, git and file downloads from executors.

```promql
sum by (route) (rate(sourcegull_http_requests_total{role=~"web|all",route=~"/.executors/.*"}[5m]))
```

Owner: platform

#### executor_api_5xx_ratio

**Share of executor API requests answered with 5xx**

- Alert (warning): [executor: share of executor API requests answered with 5xx above 5% for 15m](alerts.md#executor_api_5xx_ratio)

```promql
(sum(rate(sourcegull_http_requests_total{role=~"web|all",route=~"/.executors/.*",status=~"5.."}[15m])) or 0 * sum(rate(sourcegull_http_requests_total{role=~"web|all",route=~"/.executors/.*"}[15m])))
/ sum(rate(sourcegull_http_requests_total{role=~"web|all",route=~"/.executors/.*"}[15m]))
```

## Sourcegull: blob

The blob role stores SCIP uploads, bulk change workspace files and search job results on its volume and serves them to the other roles. With an S3-compatible store (`blobstore.mode=s3`) there is no blob role and this dashboard stays empty.

Grafana uid: `sourcegull-blob`.

### blob: Requests

#### blob_request_rate

**Blob requests per second by method and status**

`PUT` writes, `GET`/`HEAD` reads, `DELETE` removals. 404 on reads is normal for missing keys.

```promql
sum by (method, status) (rate(sourcegull_blob_requests_total{role=~"blob|all"}[5m]))
```

Owner: platform

#### blob_error_ratio

**Share of blob requests answered with 5xx**

- Alert (warning): [blob: share of blob requests answered with 5xx above 1% for 10m](alerts.md#blob_error_ratio)
- Alert (critical): [blob: share of blob requests answered with 5xx above 10% for 10m](alerts.md#blob_error_ratio)

```promql
(sum(rate(sourcegull_blob_requests_total{role=~"blob|all",status=~"5.."}[10m])) or 0 * sum(rate(sourcegull_blob_requests_total{role=~"blob|all"}[10m])))
/ sum(rate(sourcegull_blob_requests_total{role=~"blob|all"}[10m]))
```

Owner: platform

#### blob_p90_latency

**90th percentile blob request duration by method**

Until the response starts: reads stream their body afterwards, writes include receiving the upload.

```promql
histogram_quantile(0.9, sum by (le, method) (rate(sourcegull_blob_request_duration_seconds_bucket{role=~"blob|all"}[5m])))
```

Owner: platform

### blob: Instances

#### blob_instance_up

**Instances answering Prometheus scrapes**

1 while Prometheus can scrape the instance's internal listener (:6060), 0 when it cannot.

- Alert (critical): [blob: instances answering Prometheus scrapes below 1 for 5m](alerts.md#blob_instance_up)

```promql
up{role=~"blob|all"}
```

Owner: platform

## Sourcegull: postgres

Sourcegull's database, measured by the workers (`pg_stat_activity`, database size) and by every process (its connection pool). For server-level metrics (replication, I/O, vacuum), run a Postgres exporter next to it.

Grafana uid: `sourcegull-postgres`.

### postgres: Database

#### postgres_postgres_up

**Workers reaching Postgres**

1 when the last metrics collection by a worker (every 30 s) reached Postgres, else 0.

- Alert (critical): [postgres: workers reaching Postgres below 1 for 5m](alerts.md#postgres_postgres_up)

```promql
max(sourcegull_postgres_up)
```

Owner: platform

#### postgres_connections

**Connections to Sourcegull's database by state**

From `pg_stat_activity`. Many `idle in transaction` connections point to transactions left open by a client.

```promql
max by (state) (sourcegull_postgres_connections)
```

Owner: platform

#### postgres_connection_saturation

**Share of max_connections in use by Sourcegull's database**

- Alert (warning): [postgres: share of max_connections in use by Sourcegull's database above 80% for 5m](alerts.md#postgres_connection_saturation)
- Alert (critical): [postgres: share of max_connections in use by Sourcegull's database above 95% for 5m](alerts.md#postgres_connection_saturation)

```promql
sum(max by (state) (sourcegull_postgres_connections))
/ max(sourcegull_postgres_max_connections)
```

Owner: platform

#### postgres_oldest_transaction

**Age of the oldest open transaction**

- Alert (warning): [postgres: age of the oldest open transaction above 30m for 5m](alerts.md#postgres_oldest_transaction)

```promql
max(sourcegull_postgres_oldest_transaction_seconds)
```

Owner: platform

#### postgres_database_size

**Size of Sourcegull's database**

Grows with repositories, code graph data and job history. Watch the free space of the Postgres volume.

```promql
max(sourcegull_postgres_database_size_bytes)
```

Owner: platform

### postgres: Connection pools

#### postgres_pool_in_use

**Pool connections in use by process**

Connections each process has checked out of its pool. Workers next to other roles get a separate `worker` pool.

```promql
max by (role, instance, pool) (sourcegull_db_pool_connections{state="in_use"})
```

Owner: platform

#### postgres_pool_saturation

**Share of the connection pool in use by process**

- Alert (warning): [postgres: share of the connection pool in use by process above 90% for 15m](alerts.md#postgres_pool_saturation)

```promql
max by (role, instance, pool) (sourcegull_db_pool_connections{state="in_use"} / ignoring(state) sourcegull_db_pool_connections{state="max"})
```

Owner: platform
